envirofacts.description: Any Envirofacts table (DMAP): TRI, GHGRP, SDWIS, SEMS/Superfund, RCRAInfo, FRS ... filtered by column values.

table.desc: catalog alias (tri_facility, ghg_emitters, sdwis_systems ...) or schema.table

filters.desc: {"column": "value"} for equals, or [[column, operator, value], ...]; operators: equals, notEquals, lessThan, greaterThan, greaterThanEqual, beginsWith, endsWith, contains

uv_daily.description: Today's UV index forecast for a ZIP code (forecast, not history).

uv_daily_city.description: Today's UV index forecast for a city.

uv_hourly.description: Today's hourly UV index forecast for a ZIP code.

echo_facilities.description: ECHO facility compliance search (two steps: query, then pages of rows): air (CAA), cwa (CWA/NPDES), rcra (hazardous waste), sdw (drinking water systems), echo (all programs).

program.desc: air, cwa, rcra, sdw or echo

p_co.desc: county name, with p_st (returns 0 rows for program air, verified 2026-10: use p_fips there)

p_fips.desc: 5-digit state+county FIPS, e.g. 35015 (air, cwa, rcra, echo)

p_ncs.desc: NAICS code, 2 to 6 digits (shorter matches every code it begins; p_naics is ignored by ECHO)

echo_cases.description: EPA civil and criminal enforcement cases (ICIS): penalties, settlements, outcomes (two steps like echo_facilities).

p_state.desc: state code (note: p_state here, p_st is ignored)

p_law.desc: CAA, CWA, RCRA, SDWA, CERCLA, EPCRA, TSCA, FIFRA

p_case_status.desc: case status code(s), comma-separated: CLS closed, CNC concluded, FOI final order issued, CFL complaint filed ... (codes, not words: Closed matches nothing)

p_milestone_fy.desc: one fiscal year: cases with an administrative or judicial milestone in that FY (p_fy is ignored by ECHO)

p_milestone.desc: milestone code(s) to go with p_milestone_fy (codes are not listed in ECHO's service description; unverified)

p_civil_criminal_indicator.desc: CI civil, CR criminal, ALL both (p_crim is ignored by ECHO)

p_fed_penalty.desc: federal penalty assessed: ANY, LE5000, GT5000, GT50000, GT100000, GT500000, GT1000000, GT2500000

echo_facility_detail.description: Detailed Facility Report for one FRS registry id: permits, inspections, violations, enforcement (one row; sections as JSON text).

tri_facility.name: tri.tri_facility
tri_facility.description: TRI reporting facilities: name, address, county, parent company, FRS id (useful filter columns: state_abbr, county_name)

tri_reporting_form.name: tri.tri_reporting_form
tri_reporting_form.description: TRI Form R/A submissions: chemical, reporting year, facility (doc_ctrl_num links releases) (useful filter columns: reporting_year, tri_facility_id, cas_chem_name)

tri_release_qty.name: tri.tri_release_qty
tri_release_qty.description: TRI release quantities by environmental medium per form (doc_ctrl_num) (useful filter columns: doc_ctrl_num, environmental_medium)

ghg_emitters.name: ghg.ghg_emitter_sector
ghg_emitters.description: GHGRP large emitters: facility, sector, gas, CO2e emissions (metric tons) by year (useful filter columns: state, year, sector_name, gas_code)

sdwis_systems.name: sdwis.water_system
sdwis_systems.description: SDWIS public water systems: type (CWS, NTNCWS, TNCWS), population served, source, activity (useful filter columns: state_code, primacy_agency_code, pws_type_code)

sdwis_violations.name: sdwis.violation
sdwis_violations.description: SDWIS drinking water violations: rule, contaminant, health-based flag, compliance period (useful filter columns: primacy_agency_code, pwsid, is_health_based_ind)

superfund_sites.name: sems.envirofacts_site
superfund_sites.description: SEMS Superfund (CERCLA) sites: NPL status, location, federal facility flag (useful filter columns: fk_ref_state_code, npl_status_code)
